name: UI Tweaker
description: Move and scale any node of the game's interface with the mouse, then copy the C++ that puts it there

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub or in the Discord server

toggle-key.name: Edit mode
toggle-key.description: Turns the edit mode on and off. In it, the mouse picks, moves and scales the nodes of the screen instead of pressing them, and <cy>Ctrl+C</c> copies the C++ for the selected one

snap.name: Snapping
snap.description: A dragged node snaps its edges and its center to the screen's, its parent's and its siblings' within 3 points, with the guides drawn. Hold <cy>Ctrl</c> to drag without it

logger-pins.name: Pinned in Improved Logger
logger-pins.description: With <cy>Improved Logger</c>: the selected node and the count of edited nodes pinned in its console, and a marker when code is copied. Every edit and the copied code are in the log either way

language.name: Language
language.description: The edit mode's language. Auto: Russian on a Russian Windows, English otherwise. The generated code is in English either way
